cyberpanelPluginConfig.name: Limited phpMyAdmin
cyberpanelPluginConfig.description: Issue dedicated MySQL users with access to a single database for phpMyAdmin. Label grants by FTP or CyberPanel user; disable without deleting. Optional MySQL privilege profiles, strict mode and per-tab preference blocking for cpma users, one-time launch links, and policy saved under CyberCP pluginState. Free plugin.
